symptom: Oil Flow in Attachment Circuit Cannot be Changed
detail_of_failure: Oil flow in the attachment circuit cannot be changed.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Reference information • In machines with an attachment, flow rate in the service circuit changes in response to the selection of the select mode. • The procedures to adjust the flow rate are different in the ATT mode and B mode of the working mode. For details, see Operation and Maintenance Manual.

steps.cause: Attachment oil flow adjuster EPC valve
steps.procedure: 1. Start the engine. 2. Do the troubleshooting for the EPC valve output pressure with the engine at high idle. 3. Does the measurement result of the EPC valve output pressure agree with the standard value? 4. Do the troubleshooting of the current value with the monitoring function (Code: 01700). 5. Does the measurement result of the voltage value agree with the standard value?
